what: special cases set for a named entry, turned off one at a time and measured; pruned only when every measure is identical or better and no test fails (scripts/prune.py, plan 28 Task 9.3, ruling Q46)

candidates.why: = _NAME_ROUTE: a domain name keeps no more than its routing keep-out from a loop's way out (the 7NZ2 0.1 off)
a near joint no route reaches is held to the far joints' test (na_runs._straight_joint)
any aligned pair is one fold by its TM-score (align.element_mates; H1)
any aligned pair is one fold by its matched fraction (align.element_mates; H1)
no two chains are ever held together by base pairs (io._paired never true)
no base atoms pair within 0 Å: io._paired never true
a tail count need not stand beside its letter (layout.tail_counts)
mirror-image copies get no more room than other copies drawn alike (layout._separate: max(room, 0)); their extra push passes stay, as they are code
the second chance for copies drawn alike is never kept (layout._tied_again)
a stack gap needs no width to have a way out, so none is shut: no nudge, no move to the partner's other side, no pocket (layout._column_heights: they all ask way_out by _STACK_SHUT)
a strand in a shut stack gap is never nudged (layout._column_heights.opened)
an accessory closing a pocket never moves (layout._column_heights.unpocketed)
a stack gap a chain end faces gets no more room (layout._column_heights.room)
a βα row may hold any number of parallel strands (layout.can_be_row)
parting domains never starts over (layout._part_domains)
= _MAX_POLAR: a slab many elements cross is held to the ordinary polarity
no slab is crossed by enough elements to relax its polarity limit
the normal is never refitted to the crossing helices (membrane._refit)
= FLAT_TILT: a helix at a face lies flat from the ordinary tilt
no two helix runs are joined in a membrane view (membrane._apart: 1 <= gap <= 0)
no far joint is drawn straight (na_runs._straight_joint)
a route from beside a face pays nothing for cells under strands drawn before
= HBOND_MAX: no stretched pair is taken in the second pass (nucleic pairs)
no gap between a domain's padded elements is filled (panels.panel_fields)
a ligand mark is never looked for beyond _SPOT_RADIUS (render._place_mark), and _least_bad_spot's rings are narrowed to _SPOT_RADIUS too (not a faithful revert: that sweep reads the same constant)
no ring past the first clear spot is searched for fewer crossed bodies
= _SLAB_COST: a step along the slab costs what a step across it does
a page's second route searches have no shared budget (never refused)
candidates.held: it bounds the time a page's second route searches take (7QUP's focus view took 158 s of its 180), and no measure judges time; identical says these sets never spend the budget. Its named entry 7QUP's focus view drew identically without it, but 7NZ2's domains view (the held-out sample, which spends it: 6 searches refused) did not: A4 and A6 newly failed, loop_over_text 0 -> 1, helix_name_moved 0 -> 1 (one random100 run each way at 46f5ebf, outside Q46's measures). Removing it also removes route_second_search_refused and the readability floor's route_budget reason

candidates.why: a loop routed again off nucleic-acid text pays nothing for that text's cells
= _REROUTE_TURNS: a reroute off text's ink may add no more corners than off its clearance
= MIN_HELIX_COPIES_ASKED: auto calls a screw of three copies helical
